verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents autonomous diagnose-and-fix flows for related triggers. It can inspect failed CI workflow logs, identify the likely cause and open a fix PR. It can also validate security alerts and remediate them via PR. Its bug-watching automation, however, only gathers logs, suggests severity and routes the issue, and no evidence shows it fixing a user-reported bug end to end. Auto-approve mode supports unattended operation. missing for 10: documented end-to-end fixing of a reported bug or issue (not just CI failures or security alerts), independent or hands-on corroboration of fix success.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent autonomously diagnose and fix a reported bug

citations.quote: Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
Review security alerts, validate the finding, update affected code, and open a pull request with the remediation.
Watch for new bugs or incidents, gather logs and recent changes, suggest severity, and route the issue to the right owner.
